test_adidas_on_prisoners_dilemma: test the ADIDAS algorithm on a 2-player prisoner's dilemma game with MatrixGame and QRE anneal solver
test_adidas_on_elfarol: test the ADIDAS algorithm on a 10-player symmetric El Farol bar game with TensorGame and QRE anneal solver
create_adidas_solver: create an ADIDAS instance with a seed and run approximate_nash on a symmetric game to find limiting logit equilibrium
build_matrix_game: build a MatrixGame from a payoff tensor with non-negative values for 2-player symmetric games
build_elfarol_game: build an ElFarol TensorGame with n players and a crowding threshold for many-player symmetric games
